# PeopleBase

> PeopleBase is a small open source HRIS (human resources information system) built with Flask and SQLAlchemy. Employees, managers and HR admins sign in and see only what their role and reporting line allow: employees their own record, pay and time off; managers their direct and indirect reports without pay; HR everything. It covers people records, compensation history, time off with approval and leave balances, onboarding and offboarding checklists, policy acknowledgements, a headcount and attrition report and an append-only audit log. Passwords use Argon2id, the schema is managed by Alembic migrations, and the suite has 525 tests. It is a portfolio project, not a hosted product.

## Docs

- [Security model](https://github.com/patrickking67/peoplebase/blob/main/docs/security.md): trust boundaries, roles, access rules, 16 abuse cases and known limits
- [Architecture](https://github.com/patrickking67/peoplebase/blob/main/docs/architecture.md): components, data model, permission flow, audit log and migrations
- [Agent guide](https://github.com/patrickking67/peoplebase/blob/main/AGENTS.md): layout, exact commands, conventions and definition of done
- [Security policy](https://github.com/patrickking67/peoplebase/blob/main/SECURITY.md): private reporting, scope and deployment notes
- [Changelog](https://github.com/patrickking67/peoplebase/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): what changed and when

## Source

- [Repository](https://github.com/patrickking67/peoplebase): MIT licensed
- [access.py](https://github.com/patrickking67/peoplebase/blob/main/access.py): the permission model in one class
- [app.py](https://github.com/patrickking67/peoplebase/blob/main/app.py): factory, request gates, routes, validation and CLI commands
- [models.py](https://github.com/patrickking67/peoplebase/blob/main/models.py): models and the append-only audit guard
- [leave.py](https://github.com/patrickking67/peoplebase/blob/main/leave.py): leave accrual and balances
- [reports.py](https://github.com/patrickking67/peoplebase/blob/main/reports.py): headcount and attrition
- [Tests](https://github.com/patrickking67/peoplebase/tree/main/tests): pytest suite, including the route-by-role access table
